system.description:
The first veil of reality the Kiasyd learns to lift is that of untruth. The power's signs differ with each practitioner — you might weep or sweat blood, watch a liar's tongue twist into unnatural shapes, or feel a crawling sensation across your hands and neck — but the result never varies: you know a lie the instant you hear it.

When you wish to assess a statement, make a Static Mental Challenge (retest Awareness) against a difficulty equal to the subject's number of Social Traits, plus one for every Subterfuge Ability Trait he possesses. Success tells you with absolute certainty whether the statement was true or false. You must be able to hear the words as they are spoken (or read the speaker's lips if you are deaf), and you must make a separate challenge for each statement you want to analyze.
